sourceEvidence.fact: Explicit `herdr server` dispatches directly to server::headless::run_server(); it does not use auto-detect daemon spawning.
`herdr server` with no subcommand is the documented headless-server entry; `herdr server stop` sends the server stop request.
Bare `herdr` auto-detect launch may spawn a detached background daemon when no server is running; that path is forbidden for this bounded probe.
Headless server mode does not enter raw mode or read stdin, creates API/client sockets, runs the event loop, and handles explicit server stop.
`herdr status server --json` reports running state, version, protocol, capabilities, compatibility, socket and session.
HERDR_SOCKET_PATH overrides the active JSON API socket.
When HERDR_SOCKET_PATH is set, the client socket is deterministically derived beside it.
XDG_CONFIG_HOME and XDG_STATE_HOME are honored for Herdr configuration and state.
`herdr server stop` sends server.stop and waits for API/client sockets to become unreachable, with an upstream 15-second stop bound.

allowedActions: re-download the exact pinned release asset into a private temporary directory
verify exact byte size and SHA-256 before execution
run only the explicit foreground `herdr server` command under isolated HOME/XDG paths and HERDR_SOCKET_PATH
poll only `herdr status server --json` to prove local API readiness
issue only `herdr server stop` for graceful shutdown
write sanitized local untracked lifecycle evidence
force-clean the temporary server process tree if graceful shutdown fails
remove the temporary binary, sockets, logs and sandbox on exit
forbiddenActions: persist or install the Herdr binary
create or attach a Herdr client/session/workspace through CLI commands
run Herdr update, integration, plugin or remote commands
mutate Android device_config, phantom-process limits or battery policy
probe.successGate: exact verified binary starts `herdr server`, reports running v0.8.0 with compatible protocol over the isolated API socket, accepts `herdr server stop`, exits without forced cleanup, and reports not_running afterward
probe.failureGate: any prerequisite, download, digest, server-start, status, identity, protocol, stop, exit or cleanup failure keeps tmux canonical and records sanitized evidence

proofCeiling: This source snapshot approves one foreground, isolated, checksum-verified server start/status/stop probe after exact-device prebuilt execution identity has already passed. It does not authorize installation, daemon auto-launch, client attach, detach/reattach, persistence, agent-state detection, Android background survival, coding-agent work, or tmux retirement.
